scripts.predev: npm run -s schema && npm run -s wasm
scripts.prebuild: npm run -s schema && npm run -s wasm
scripts.server: npm run -s schema && npm run -s wasm && npm run -s bake && wrangler dev --config server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.server:deploy: npm run -s schema && npm run -s wasm && npm run -s bake && wrangler deploy --config server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.server:bundle: npm run -s schema && npm run -s wasm && npm run -s bake && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config server/wrangler.jsonc --outdir ../target/server && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config server/accounts/wrangler.jsonc --outdir ../../target/accounts
scripts.accounts: wrangler d1 migrations apply overlook-accounts --local --config server/accounts/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev --config server/accounts/wrangler.jsonc --port 8788 --var 'PAGES:http://localhost:5173/ http://127.0.0.1:5173/'
scripts.bot: wrangler d1 migrations apply noshores-bot --local --config server/bot/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev --config server/bot/wrangler.jsonc --port 8789 --var 'PANEL_ORIGINS:http://localhost:5174'
scripts.wasm: cargo build -q -p world-wasm -p land-wasm -p movement-wasm -p room-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.mkdirSync('client/public',{recursive:true});for(const name of ['world','land','movement','room'])fs.copyFileSync('target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/'+name+'_wasm.wasm','client/public/'+name+'.wasm')"
scripts.types: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json
